item.title: Framed Vaquero Wall Art Print, Western Desert Painting
item.description: "The Posse Is Two Hours Late." A vaquero with a magnificent mustache leans off his horse at the edge of a canyon and looks back. Far down the trail, three riders kick up dust. They will get here eventually. He has already decided he won't be waiting. Every print comes with a listening card: scan it and play the song we paired with the painting. Printed & shipped from the USA, framed or unframed. Original artwork by Atmosférico FM, created with AI-assisted tools.
